translations.web: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
translations.bsb: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father—though not the daughter of my mother—and she became my wife.
translations.kjv: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
translations.asv: And moreover she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife:
